assistworld-assist-world:lever:ae53433e-.description: Overview Rocket Resume is an online resume-building platform founded in 2018, currently pivoting to also serve B2B customers through a new sister company, Ship Crew, which will build and provide the services Rocket Resume runs on. The founder, Steve, is an engineer by background who is deeply focused on product and growth, and needs an Executive Assistant who can take email and admin off his plate quickly, then grow into owning SEO content execution, a small content team, and light operations for a fully remote, globally distributed company. Key Responsibilities Phase 1 — Executive Support (first 2 weeks priority) • Take ownership of the founder's email inbox — learning his voice and tone, triaging, drafting and sending responses, and following up so nothing falls through the cracks • Manage his calendar and scheduling across a distributed, global team spanning multiple time zones • Help build a simple system (ideally AI-assisted) for processing physical mail and lower-priority inbox items Ongoing — SEO, Content & Operations (core of the role) • Own execution of an aggressive SEO content roadmap — researching search terms, briefing and producing high volumes of targeted, well-optimized blog content aimed at ranking for terms like "resume builder" • Build and manage a small team of content writers/creators (often international) to scale content production without the founder managing each piece directly • Test and manage organic growth channels beyond search (e.g. Pinterest, relevant online communities and groups) to drive traffic to content • Take a self-directed, solutions-first approach — proposing and building processes rather than waiting to be told exactly what to do • Check in regularly (including a monthly meeting) with the customer support team on the founder's behalf, since this function currently runs with minimal oversight • Support light project management — coordinating with the CMO, a content writer, and other contributors to keep initiatives on track • Use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.) daily to automate repetitive tasks across email, content, and workflows Personal Support (lighter, as needed) • Help with occasional travel planning and coordination for the founder • Support with household logistics or errands as they come up Tools & Systems in Use • Slack (primary team communication — team works async across time zones), Stripe • Blog/CMS on the Rocket Resume website; no formal SEO tooling or content workflow in place yet — this role will help build it • AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) integrated into daily workflows Company & Team Context • Fully remote, always-on team: head of engineering (Australia), engineers (Central America), engineering contractors (Poland), design firm (Ukraine), customer support (Jamaica/Bahamas), and marketing (US-based) • Business is subscription-based (short low-cost trial converting to a monthly or annual plan); growth is driven almost entirely by search, not social/brand discovery • Company is currently rebuilding its website and expanding from B2C into B2B, with a strong focus on global reach and conversion-rate optimization Ideal Candidate Profile • Minimum 3–4 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, with meaningful exposure to SEO, content, or marketing operations • Startup background preferred over strictly corporate/process-heavy environments — comfortable with ambiguity and building process from scratch • Self-directed and solutions-oriented — able to propose and run with a plan rather than needing detailed direction on every task • Comfortable owning and eventually managing a small team of content writers/creators • Working knowledge of how SEO for search engines (not just social media) actually works — keyword research, on-page content strategy, ranking factors • Comfortable adopting AI tools as part of daily workflow, ideally with concrete examples of using AI to automate inbox, content, or operational tasks • Strong communicator, able to interface confidently with a

brinc-brinc:ashbyhq:f4d9cc60-7807-4446-8.description: ABOUT BRINC: At BRINC, we are redefining public safety with an innovative ecosystem of life-saving tools. Our journey started with the development of drones and ruggedized throw phones, designed to access unsafe areas and establish communication to de-escalate situations. Today, we've expanded into creating and deploying 911 response networks, where drones are dispatched to 911 calls to provide real-time visual data, enhancing safety and enabling de-escalation-focused responses. Our cutting-edge solutions are utilized by over 600 public safety agencies across America and the company has raised over $150M from investors, including Index Ventures, Motorola Solutions, Sam Altman, Dylan Field, Mike Volpe, Alexandr Wang and more. At BRINC, we are committed to recruiting the world's best talent to join us in our mission to support first responders in saving lives. compasssurgicalpartners-compass-surgical.title: Director of Corporate Development
compasssurgicalpartners-compass-surgical.description: Compass Surgical Partners is a leading, independent, full-service ambulatory surgery center (ASC) development and management partner. An exclusive partner for premier health systems, Compass has built a nationwide portfolio of ASC joint ventures with health systems and physicians. Compass’ experienced leadership team has developed more than 250 ASCs over the past three decades, making it the partner of choice for high-performance ASCs. Differentiated by a proven track record of success and an agile, aligned operating model, Compass Surgical Partners aims to create strong partnerships that improve the lives of patients and providers. Learn more at www.compass-sp.com http://www.compass-sp.com. ROLE OVERVIEW Compass Surgical Partners is seeking a strategic growth leader to drive the expansion of our ambulatory surgery center network through physician partnerships, joint ventures, and market development. This is more than a traditional corporate development role. As Director of Corporate Development, you'll identify new growth opportunities, cultivate trusted relationships with physicians and health system leaders, and lead complex transactions that shape the future of our organization. Working closely with physicians, health systems, executive leadership, and cross-functional partners, you'll represent Compass in the marketplace while sourcing, structuring, negotiating, and executing strategic partnerships that create long-term value for our partners and our organization. Drive Growth. Build Partnerships. Expand Our Network. WHAT YOU'LL DO Drive Strategic Growth - Build and manage a robust pipeline of high-value ambulatory surgery center partnership opportunities across existing and new markets - Develop strategic outreach plans targeting physician groups, health systems, and other key referral sources - Identify and prioritize new market opportunities through data-driven analysis of physician alignment, demographics, competitive dynamics, and healthcare market trends - Exercise sound business judgment to prioritize opportunities, balance competing stakeholder interests, and focus resources on partnerships with the greatest long-term strategic value - Represent Compass in the marketplace, strengthening our reputation as the preferred partner for physicians and health systems Build Trusted Physician Partnerships - Establish deep, trust-based relationships with physician owners, practice leaders, hospital executives, governing boards, and other key stakeholders - Lead consultative discussions that uncover partner objectives and align Compass's partnership model with their strategic and financial goals - Deliver compelling presentations that clearly communicate Compass's value proposition, investment philosophy, and operating model - Foster long-term relationships that support successful physician syndication, repeat partnerships, and continued market growth - Serve as a trusted advisor throughout the partnership lifecycle, creating an exceptional experience for prospective partners Structure & Execute Strategic Partnerships - Originate, structure, negotiate, and close complex joint venture opportunities from initial engagement through signed agreements - Serve as the quarterback for each transaction, coordinating internal and external stakeholders, removing obstacles, and maintaining momentum throughout lengthy transaction cycles - Structure partnerships that align Compass's financial objectives with the long-term success of our physician and health system partners - Collaborate closely with Finance, Legal, Operations, Clinical, and Executive Leadership to ensure transactions are thoughtfully structured, compliant, and successfully executed - Drive disciplined execution while maintaining visibility into timelines, milestones, and deal progression Expand Into New Markets - Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify attractive growth opportunities and support strategic market expansion - Build local market presence

WHAT we believe We believe that collaboration is the foundation for success. We work as a business advocate for our clients – providing personalized service and building long-term relationships to help position our clients for the future. HOW we succeed We are deeply committed to our core values of Bright Minds, Brave Hearts and Bold Actions and incorporate them into every aspect of our business. By living these values, we are able to meet our strategic objectives of Remaining Fiercely Independent (financial success), Meeting client demands/needs (client success), Reinforcing and expanding cultural distinction (people success). Role Overview GHJ Search and Staffing is seeking a motivated and experienced Staffing Manager to specialize in the placement of Interim and Temporary Accounting and Finance professionals. As a key member of our team, you will be instrumental in connecting top-tier finance and accounting professionals with leading companies, playing a vital role in both career advancement and organizational success. The Staffing Manager will be responsible for the full-cycle recruitment of accounting and finance professionals, including temporary, contract, and interim roles. This position requires a consultative approach to effectively manage client relationships and provide expert guidance to candidates. You will be a trusted partner, leveraging GHJ’s reputation for deep industry expertise and quality service to deliver exceptional results.
responsibilities: Specialized Recruitment:  Execute full-cycle recruitment for a variety of Accounting and Finance positions (e.g., Accountants, Payroll, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Financial Analysts, Controllers, CFOs) across various industries.

Client Relationship Management:  Develop and maintain strong, long-term partnerships with hiring managers by understanding their specific talent needs, providing market intelligence, and delivering tailored staffing solutions.
Talent Acquisition:  Source, screen, interview, and evaluate candidates to ensure a strong match between their skills, career goals, and the client's organizational culture and requirements.
Candidate Advocacy:  Provide professional guidance to job seekers, including resume advice, interview coaching, and current market insights, acting as a career consultant.
Consultative Sales:  Act as a subject matter expert in the Accounting and Finance labor market, consulting with clients on hiring strategies, compensation trends, and competitive positioning.
Process Management:  Manage all aspects of the placement process, including negotiating compensation, presenting offers, and facilitating a seamless transition for both the client and the candidate.
qualifications: Proven experience in full-cycle staffing, recruiting, or sales, preferably within the Accounting and Finance sector.
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with an ability to build rapport quickly.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, or a related field is preferred.
